availability: Shared candidate service and private native command probe. Product handler/composition and frontend journeys remain unavailable until qualified; no stable public ABI is frozen.
prepare: image verify prepare <case_operation_id> <image> --map <map> --case-state-dir <directory> --state-dir <existing-empty-execution-directory>. Read only the explicitly selected acquisition metadata/image/map and current code/parents. Return an exact source/code/resource/store definition with execution_admitted false. Create no output or operation, and perform no verification scan. Reject substituted selections and malformed/oversized provider replies before presenting a review.
execute: image verify execute --definition-json <object> --definition-digest <sha256> --allow-case-read --allow-image-read --allow-map-read --allow-store-write --allow-host-effects --allow-private-metadata. All six flags and the exact wrapper digest are required before the execution port. Retention contains private routing/raw metadata; this is not a support export. No inferred grant, force, overwrite, automatic retry, restart or cleanup. Source reading and owned metadata writes are distinct declared effects.
responses: Prepare completes/0 without execution admission. Execute accepted_running/5 only with a bound verify-op ID, a complete validated active history and observed running worker. Completed/0 requires a matched terminal verdict, verified collection retention, passed collection validation and applicable case/image attachment at the recorded observation. Mismatch, incomplete, cancelled and refused terminal verification become failed/4. Uncertain verdict/applicability/retention or invalid/throwing/oversized replies after dispatch become unknown/6, preserving reviewed digest, execution directory and any allocated valid ID. Pre-dispatch provider/definition refusal is refused/3; invalid parameters are refused/2.
observation: Completed inspection/0 means a completed observation request, not a successful logical verification. Compare the separately reported retained request binding against the state. Revalidate exact definition, operation/attempt/worker/capture/code/PID bindings, counters, verdict and retention relationships. Native retained history/collection validation remains necessary. A cancellation request stays separate from worker observation; late cancellation cannot rewrite an already fixed verdict. Historical verification establishes no present-day image authority or source preservation.
watch: The proposed org.disked.verification-operation-events/1 feature applies only to operation.watch with a verify-op selector. Bound each event to an exact retained request/record, separate request/observer identity and the operation/attempt/worker/capture domain. Reject stale/conflicting/gapped cursors transactionally. Finite follow is at most 2000 ms; at most 64 delivered events and 786432 aggregate event bytes per observer. Preserve the last validated state/cursor if later reads fail. Closing an observer or timing out never cancels, restarts or frees the worker.
limits: Public input remains 65536 bytes including envelope/framing, with its existing depth/value/string budgets. A private 262144-byte definition may not fit a public request: require a separate 65536-byte, depth-32, 8192-value public definition bound before presentation/dispatch. Structured replies stay inside one MiB including LF. Verification reply values are separately bounded; watch batches reserve room for an unknown diagnostic. A post-dispatch bound failure is unknown, never a fabricated no-effect refusal.
qualification: Define expected outputs before evaluation. Compare common CLI, typed form and protocol requests for no-output prepare, exact grants, actual self-spawn/records/collection, same-generation byte mismatch, partial cancellation, delayed admission and repeated observation. Independently validate producer schemas/relationships and retained native hashes/process identities. Exercise malformed foreign replies and all missing grants with port-call counters, declared public/private byte boundaries, cursor/event contradictions and observer failures. Keep synthetic edits distinct from real provider effects. Actual product GUI/TUI/shell and bounded request-channel journeys are a later required gate.
next_gate: Select this exact verification handler/adapter in the product composition and qualify actual native CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell, request stalls and negotiated events before advertising availability. Full DE-W034 and all specified platform/storage, owner, physical/elevation/customer/install/signing/publication gates remain open.
